author: Limidi
body:
Hi! I am Here with my second map.

ENDER CITY CTF
I love making maps, so I created another one, This one is a CTF, and It is called ender City. I made a backstory up for this one!










BackStory: Long Long ago, There was a busling town called End. End was located at the far northern corner of the minecraft world. North World was unsettling and war-torn, because of the Great Desert wars of 1603 BCE. There was a constant struggle for power all around End, but End itself was perfectly fine, with its 50 foot high walls. The yellow side, Or the north, often exported an odd substance called Endstone. This was uniquely found in the end, and all the other provences were jeaulous of this beautiful material. The city of end was richer than ever, but a looming conflict grew outside the walls. Under the city, however, was a jumbling mass of tunnels, where someone had rumored buried their treasure. There had been talk of a machine, capable of throwing cities to other worlds. In the closed world of End, people did not believe it. One thursday Morning, at about 8 O'Clock, A rumbling noise was heard outside the mighty city walls. It was an army of 20,000. This was way more than the 5,000 people of End, but they decided to put up a fight. For 7 days and 7 nights, there was bitter fighting in End. The northern armies of Wither, having won the power struggle, Atttacked the weakened city on the 8th night. The moon was new, and the stars were covered by the endless clouds. Wither and his army rushed the city gates, and pillaged the city. The mayor was in shock, and weeped to himself as he raised the white flag above the dual town halls. Wither then pulled out a device. The people stood in awe. Then, a wooshing noise. All of a sudden, End was in a new place. This did not look like World. Over the years, the people changed. they grew tall and black, with long arms. They were threatened daily by an awful dragon. They decided to name this dimension End, after the town that used to be.

Igmur Album: http://imgur.com/a/9q9Cl

XML: http://pastebin.com/qha4AayD (I think this is right)

Tell me what you think!

Changelog:

1.1 : Added 2 more buildings, added tunnel system\

1.2: Only Added Lights to make PVP Better, No change to download or igmur yet.

replies.author: PieZ
replies.body:
Your map has been denied by the Map Developers for the following reasons.

1.9 blocks- You have blocks that are in 1.9 which isn't the version we primarily use. Please replace those blocks.

Too flat and simple- Your map is very flat which is good for pvp space but it just gets repetitive after a while. Find a good space in between getting a good flat area to pvp and good levels.

You may submit the map after those edits have been made.
